## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change (unit for logic, component for UI, end-to-end for user flows)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test:ci` and `npm run e2e` pass locally
- [ ] Visual baselines updated if the UI changed on purpose (`npm run e2e:visual:update`)
- [ ] Accessible: works from the keyboard, has accessible names, and passes the axe checks
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `docs/`, ADRs) where behaviour or architecture changed
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits
